nodes.title: 真实人像四视图提示词（四宫格版本）中文对照

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the single person whose facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, and makeup come from <Picture 1>, with facial details supplemented by <Picture 3>, <Picture 4>, <Picture 5>, and <Picture 6>, and who wears the exact outfit, accessories, and footwear shown in <Picture 2>; <Picture 2> also provides her body proportions. The outfit of <Picture 2> is transferred onto <Subject 1> unchanged in style, colors, materials, and details, and she wears it in every shot; all attributes are combined into this one person.

summary:
[reference generation] A 2-second 9:16 vertical video on a plain light-grey studio background with soft, even lighting. <Subject 1> is the sole subject: the face and hairstyle follow <Picture 1>, and the full outfit, accessories, and footwear follow <Picture 2> in all four shots. Four shots of 0.5 seconds each, connected by hard cuts with no transitions, present in order: a front half-body chest-up portrait, a three-quarter side half-body view, a back full-body view, and a front full-body view, serving as standard four-panel reference material. Within each shot the subject is completely still and the camera is locked off, with a sharp, clear image, accurate color, and a clean portrait-photography look.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): partially_preserved - the facial features, hairstyle, skin tone, and makeup are fully preserved from <Picture 1>, supplemented by <Picture 3>, <Picture 4>, <Picture 5>, and <Picture 6>, and serve as the identity anchor; the outfit, accessories, footwear, and body proportions are an attribute_transfer from <Picture 2>: <Picture 2>'s clothing is worn by <Subject 1> in every shot and replaces the clothing visible in the face references. Angles and details not covered by the references (such as the back of the hairstyle and the outfit's back details) are completed by plausible inference, self-consistent with the references in style, color, material, and build, with no conflicting new elements introduced.

detailed_description:
The target video uses a clean, sharp portrait-photography look with accurate color, soft even studio lighting, and a plain light-grey background.
[Shot 1] A front half-body chest-up portrait of <Subject 1>, framed from the chest up with both shoulders fully in frame. <Subject 1> faces the camera directly; the facial features, hairstyle, and expression strictly follow <Picture 1>; the eyes look straight into the lens. The clothing visible from the chest up is the outfit of <Picture 2>. Locked-off front camera at eye level. Plain light-grey background. The frame is completely still.
